title: q5 leader-33 through leader-35 closure, P-footprint quotient, and leader-36 wall
outcomes: Pass5198: corrected cubic parity by charging only fully occupied apartments; q5 leader 33 closed and strict-counterexample leader barrier raised to 34.
Pass5199: degree-edge-type upper bound on five-edge paths/full apartments; q5 leader 34 closed and barrier raised to 35.
Pass5200: profilewise maximum of ordinary and full-apartment-corrected cubic bounds; q5 leader 35 closed with tight lower bound 627 and barrier raised to 36.
Pass5201: odd-q P-component parity is a chamber-cut-gauge invariant point-footprint quotient.
Pass5202: at q=5 ker(F^T) equals the rank-91 W(3,5) binary line-incidence code; the same rank complement is exhaustively verified at q=3 and q=7.
Pass5203: P-component point blocks form the SRG family with q=5 instance SRG(325,144,68,60); W-point footprints are maximum Delsarte 25-cliques.
Pass5204: shared manuscript insert, frontier-manifest integration, public theorem page, and idempotent homepage materializer/workflow.
Pass5205: exact diagnostic wall at leader 36; unresolved adjacent-pair window is N1=54..64 with current best bounds 584,551,531,542,553,574,535,556,567,579,590.
next_frontiers: Apply Pass5185 full cut-coset inequalities to the eleven leader-36 critical degree profiles.
Determine the exact minimum distance of the q5 [325,65] P-footprint clique-span; weight 25 exists but no lower-weight exclusion is yet certified.
Analyze the zero P-component-parity residual after the Pass5202 line-gauge normal form.
Classify the weight-625 equality shell without importing a false P/L tensor symmetry.
boundary: Pass5200 proves only that every q5 word of weight <625 has minimum chamber leader at least 36. Pass5205 does not close leader 36. The q5/all-q minimum-distance theorem and the weight-625 equality shell remain open. P-side quotient results do not imply an L-side tensor decomposition, and the footprint-code minimum distance is not claimed to be 25.
